yearend rv market reality check what im seeing as 2025 wraps up as we close out 2025 i wanted to share what im actually seeing in the used rv market right now both the opportunities and the serious warnings you need to know about yearend market dynamics the yearend market tells an interesting story people are looking to unload units in an uncertain economy some are serious sellers who need to move inventory before 2026 others are just testing the waters seeing what spring and summer might bring for pricing if youre shopping right now you might find motivated sellers but spring traditionally brings more selection and activity whats moving steadily even in the slower winter season certain categories keep moving larger class bs continue to be consistent sellers brands like thor coachmen and forest river in this category are holding their appeal easier to drive than class as more amenitypacked than smaller bs mid to small travel trailers remain very popular manageable size easier towing lower entry price point 4x4 chassis models both diesel and gas are in demand people want capability and arent as concerned about fuel type as they are about going where they want to go class cs in the midsize range mirror the class b trend that sweet spot of capability without intimidation the offgrid trend and a critical warning heres where i need to get serious with you theres a strong push toward allelectric lithiumion solarequipped offgrid capable models people want selfsufficiency manufacturers are responding its becoming hard to avoid these systems even if you wanted to but this comes with risks most buyers dont understand i recently saw a unit come in where the owner garagekept it good practice right but left the house batteries on the batteries drained completely and went into sleep mode a protective feature in lithium systems the problem the manufacturer couldnt get the batteries out of sleep mode the fix required complete battery replacement the bill multiple thousands of dollars insurance wouldnt cover it extended warranty wouldnt touch it operator error they said this is what im talking about when i say these systems come with a price beyond the sticker if youre buying one of these modern electricheavy rigs ask every question you can think of understand the battery system completely know what puts batteries in sleep mode know what voids warranty understand what insurance does and doesnt cover get everything in writing factor in potential replacement costs lithium batteries arent cheap the technology is impressive the capability is real but operator error can cost you a vacations worth of money or more whats struggling large fifth wheels remain a question mark even with fuel prices dropping which helps the broader war on fuel vehicles narrative has created uncertainty in this segment buyers are hesitant about big rigs even when operational costs improve its not entirely rational fuel is cheaper now than its been in a while but market sentiment doesnt always follow logic perception matters as much as reality when it comes to resale value what changed in 2025 the 10year rule has become a much bigger topic of conversation more buyers are aware of it now more sellers are feeling its impact on values units approaching that 10year mark are seeing steeper depreciation than they should based on condition alone the shift toward electriclithiumsolar systems accelerated this year its becoming standard rather than premium thats changing the used market older units without these systems are seen as outdated even if theyre perfectly functional looking toward 2026 based on what im seeing now i expect spring 2026 to bring increased activity people who are waiting now will likely jump in once weather improves and they can actually use the rv the offgrid capable segment will continue growing the learning curve for buyers will too hopefully before they make expensive mistakes the 10year rule will keep impacting values if youre buying something approaching that age factor it into your negotiations and your expectations yearend buying advice if youre shopping now advantages of buying yearend motivated sellers trying to close deals before 2026 less competition from other buyers dealers wanting to move inventory before new year disadvantages limited selection compared to spring cant really try before you buy in winter weather harder to spot exterior issues water damage etc in coldsnow if you can wait spring brings more inventory and better inspection conditions but youll pay closer to asking prices if youre buying now negotiate hard sellers have reasons to move just dont rush the inspection process because of season or pressure the battery system warning again im repeating this because its that important modern rvs with advanced electrical systems are impressive theyre also complex one mistake like leaving batteries on during storage can cost you thousands of dollars that no warranty will cover before you buy understand the system completely get written operating instructions know what actions void coverage budget for potential battery replacement ask the seller what mistakes can i make with this system that will cost me money if they cant answer that question clearly thats a red flag about the unit or the sellers knowledge closing thoughts 2025 showed us an rv market in transition technology is advancing buyer priorities are shifting economic uncertainty is real the 10year rule is biting harder but people still want to travel families still want adventures the rv lifestyle isnt going anywhere as we head into 2026 the fundamentals remain do your research inspect thoroughly understand what youre buying especially the electrical systems and negotiate based on real value rather than emotion happy holidays and heres to smarter rv buying in 2026 rv going my way ps starting in january ill be covering specific models common problems by brandyear and answering reader questions got a specific rv youre considering hit reply and let me know your question might become a future post

the true danger of holding bitcoin youve all heard about the usual dangers of holding bitcoin losing your private keys an exchange getting hacked a 51 attack a hard drive failure some even worry about extreme scenarios like a massive solar storm wiping out digital infrastructure but the real danger of holding bitcoin is something far more fundamental it isnt technical accidental or catastrophic it lies in the fact that what you are holding is a mirage a ghost a collective illusion when you buy bitcoin you receive nothing that can be psychically used no mass or volume your receive a number a balance and if that balance truly represents something valuable something worth the enormous amount of electricity required to maintain the system then it must allow you to extract something real after all you currently have to pay around 90000 for that balance to increase by one yet the reality is that you can extract literally nothing from it what is being sold is a mirage why when you examine any traditional financial balance you find that it represents someone elses liability for a balance to be legitimate there must be an individual or institution that has taken on a liability because it is precisely from this liability that balance holders extract value when a liability is fulfilled the holder receives real economic benefits lets look at some concrete examples the balance in a stock brokers account represents the companys liability when the company distributes profits conducts a share buyback or liquidates its operations it is obligated to make payments to the holders of that balance the balance in a commodity brokers account represents the liability of the broker or intermediary institution toward the balance holder that liability involves enabling delivery of the contracted commodity or executing a cash payment equivalent to its value depending on the trading conditions and the type of contract the balance in a bank account represents the banks liability toward the balance holder and at the same time the liability of the banks debtor toward the bank this balance arises when a bank commercial or central approves a loan to an individual company or state debtors use this balance in the market to obtain labor services and goods because they are obligated to repay the loan they must ultimately return goods labor and services to the balance holders while the state allows taxes to be paid using this balance if the loan is not repaid the bank seizes the debtors real estate equipment or vehicles and sells them at auction to balance holders thus through the fulfillment of underlying liability bank balance holders realize tangible benefits goods labor services tax relief and physical assets bitcoin stands in stark contrast in bitcoin there is no liability at all there is no issuer no debtor and no institution that owes anything to the holder the system consists of a protocol that assigns computational tasks consumes energy and if those tasks are completed records a number under an identifier in a distributed database users control cryptographic keys that allow them to move numbers between identifiers and that is literally it no claim is created no liability is recorded no future delivery of goods services or assets is required the system appears as a financial balance but it is merely a mechanism for reassigning numbers between identifiers no holder can extract any economic benefit from it all those skyhigh prices all the hype and all the discussion are built on an illusion all promotion of bitcoin as an inflation hedge scarce or valuable is a category error inflation arises from excessive or diluted liabilities in a banking system since bitcoin has no underlying liability it cannot hedge against excessive or diluted liabilities scarcity refers to a limited amount of an existing resource mass volume or liability not a rule about the maximum sum of numbers in a system value results from evaluating that resource spending electricity or paying to have a number increased is not evaluation there is nothing to evaluate in a number and with nothing to evaluate there cannot be value all promotion of bitcoin serves a single purpose to attract the public to give up physical assets or real financial balances that deliver tangible value in exchange for ghost balances that deliver nothing it is obvious why this is dangerous illusions mirages and hype by their very nature cannot last forever sooner or later reality asserts itself a system built on collective belief rather than liabilities claims or tangible value is destined to fail when that collapse comes all the resources poured into maintaining it the electricity the infrastructure the opportunity cost of real assets surrendered become sunk costs with no return holders who traded real financial claims will find there is simply nothing to extract the danger is not theoretical it is baked into the bitcoin itself

a randoms thoughts on metroid prime 4 thought id write my own review of prime 4 here after beating the game if anyone would like to hear the ramblings of an internet random lol overallmiscellaneous things this is certainly a different kind of metroid a pilotable vehicle a desert hub world npcs which accompany you much more voice acting a good amount of tracks with electric guitar in themultimately i still think this is a good game despite the departure from traditional metroid conventions and something i had fun with and genuinely liked a good part of the game design philosophy seems to be built around the viola much like how arkham knight was built around the batmobile the main suit is named after it it has its own amiibo you can upgrade it in various waysi think this was ultimately why the desert was created to give people the freedom to use it often and ride around its apparent to me that its crucial to prime 4s design the nomenclature and naming of the locations could be better flare pool and viewros dont sound like typical metroid or creative enough names to mei wouldve preferred the more extraterrestrialsounding names from entries past was not too thrilled when i first saw the names in the trailer im not sure if esperpsychic powers fit samus tbh also the red viola suit is good enough looking even if its not my fav i still think classic orange purple and blue are the colors that suit her best no pun intended not much of a hindrance though as it did not deter me from playing and enjoying the game i havent verified if this is true but i heard exbungie and 343 devs had joined retro to work on prime 4if so i can feel the halo influence for sure the title screen the lamorn architecture the greater use of electric guitar in the music the gal feds and their voice acting the design of the gal feds they all look like theyre wearing generic spartan armor for the most partmackenzies suit glasses also feel very american xbox shooter gameishit all feels very westernized a good amount i dont think it hurts the game much though in some cases it serves it well gameplaycombat shooting your beam itself feels good and the strafing felt quicker to me as well though it could be because of some janky joycons too general movement also felt great as did the riding around in the viola however because i played on handheld mode i usually do for most switch games anyway i struggled sometimes with the aiming this really came to a head against the final boss especially i had to go into freehand joycon mode just because it was not feasible to progress the fight otherwise i was dreading fighting them on hard mode but luckily freehand joy cons with the pointing was much more pleasant and fun so i think ill go with this controller mode as ill probably have a better time on other bosses too aiming the control beam was also sometimes a pain in the ass even with my preferred inverted horizontal controls makes me realize just how good prime 3 was when it came to aiming one thing they shouldve done is have the startpause menu to be accessed via the plus button and to call the viola with the minus one instead of the other way around many times i got confused between the 2 which resulted in some game overs lol even in the endgame i like the different beams and shots you use my favorite was the super thunder shot the continuous stream reminded me of the wavebuster from prime 1 i do miss some of the different visors though like the thermal and xray ones some of the best bosses in the series i had fun with all of them final boss was also pretty good too aside from the previously mentioned aiming issues the difficulty is also just right imo on my hard mode playthrough right now im having a great time one thing i didnt like during the final fight though was the checkpoint system i kept going back to the beginning of phase 2 i was a bit taken aback by the final sequence which i talk about below that i intentionally did not warp awaypress a just to see what would happenwas a bit pissed i had to do the whole fight over again as a result though the general fun of it soon overtook any negative feelings phase 2 also reminded me of the final neo cortex fight in crash 2 as well as the corridor anubis fight in zone of the enders 2 the puzzles were also good i even had to google a few just to see how to do them the green crystal fetch quest at the end did not bother me too much since i was somewhat diligent about getting them over the course of the game what i dont like about it is that you need to get every single crystal in the game for 200 and all for some extra gallery artworks i love that retro always has concept art as a reward in its games but this time it is not a satisfactory enough reward for such a cumbersome task mackenzie continuing to ping you more than frequently while driving in the desert is also something that ticked me off once in a while as others have noted i wouldve liked more stock enemy variety as you mostly fight grievers and some robots prime 1 alone had flora insects sheegoth space pirates chozo ghosts metroids etc level design i liked the world and level design sol valley included each environment was nice and interesting to explore for different reasons even if they were pretty linear i know people are criticizing this game for having its biomes be too hallwayish but i believe the same can be same said about prime 1 and 3 havent beat 2 yet hoping to play a remastered version someday for instance in prime 1 you could travel between areas without the need of a hub like between phendrana drifts and magmoor cavernsbut aside from chozo ruins the biomes themselves were fairly linear and forwardmoving to me those previous 2 and phazon mines especially i think the same could also be said of prime 3s skytown and bryyo too imo its more accurate to say that the shape of prime 4s biome maps and the accessibility of most rooms are far more simpler as prime 4s rooms generally only have one entrance and one exitbut again i dont think this hurts the game every room was interesting enough to look at and scan that i wasnt even really thinking about the intricacy whats lost in this game is definitely the interconnectivity between areas that metroid is famous forbut once again i dont think the game suffers because of it i always felt said area interconnectivity was something more valid for 2d metroid anyway as opposed to the prime games so its not a stain on the game for me the desert also did not bother me as i enjoyed driving the viola and exploring it i think the emptiness and silence helps to up the eeriness of the planet and to illustrate the lamorns extinction too its also just pretty to look at as well so im fine with it and yes i think the various things to do are substantial enough i can imagine a prime 5 will be filled with more stuff to do if they decide to go for a central hub again story my biggest complaint about this game is probably the disappointing story but not because of the gal fed troopers metroid to me has always been a series about environmental storytelling with a great emphasis on isolated atmospheric moods and with some character moments sparsely put in between as mentioned earlier the troopers accompaniment and the increased voice acting only help to lessen said isolationbut nonetheless i still liked them even though they are characterized pretty generically there was nothing revolutionary about them and my least fav was prob nora though she never made me irritated or anything like that i dont think metroid should shy away from having more lively atmospheres in the future whether its with gal fed npcs or some other groupi think it would be an interesting experiment to undertake one of the 3 reasons i think the story is disappointing is because of sylux although his boss fights are fun a good amount of the hype and buildup for this game existed because we wanted to know about his character the motivation for hating samus is very underwhelming and he just was not fleshed out and showcased properly at all he certainly appears enough times but we all wouldve liked more detail about him in general we dont even learnwhy he was seeking the lamorn artifact or what he planned to do with it or how he intended use it another reason im underwhelmed by the plot is because of the subpar ending i dont believe samus would choose to teleport away while leaving the gal fed troopers behind to deal with sylux i think mackenzie wouldve been able to fix the teleporter with enough time too the ending was just too uninspiring as most people guessed the gal feds would not get a happy ending anyway i looked at the experience of the 3 scriptwriters and it was not very encouraging which explains the poor story imo one positive thing i can say about the last sequence though is thatvues missile attack on syluxwas pretty sick another thing i thought couldve been better written is the lamorn predicament for a game whose buildup and hype was riding on sylux they chose instead to develop the lamorn more its nice to explore a new alien culture but i think said exploration was just ok why give so many names to similar looking aliens if you dont make them distinct enough and flesh them out properly i also dont understand why they had to create these teleporter keys and give them to guardians for samusthe chosen one to obtain instead of just using it themselves to escape extinction i mightve missed or not paid attention while playing the game but i just did not understand it 12 of the 13 lamorn survivors already departed for other lands so why even make the whole lamorn fruit plot point besides the obvious reason neededto make a game lol they were all intelligent enough as well so they couldve just shared their knowledge on these other worlds and recultivated their history on their own samuss voice is a bit too vulnerable and i dont like how much she grunts and moans in this game lol on the flipside though i laugh when mackenize has bloodcurdling screams after he gets hit lmao sound the music is amazing as usual and prime music is once again in strong form here i might like the music in other metroid games more but volt forge the viola trials and ice belt are some of the ones that stand out to me the eerie and isolated pieces also do well to evoke those feelings of tension and apprehension as you explore the world too the sound effects and design is also pretty topnotch the vocalization that happens when you see a griever can be unnerving graphics as you may have read in other reviews this game is fucking pretty and gorgeous to look at they really need to take a bow for how good everything looks as mentioned earlier its one reason why i dont mind the desert either final thoughts for a game stuck in dev hell for 8 years i think this was a more than acceptable and great result i dont know if a numerical score really captures what i feel but i guess id go with a 75810 thanks for reading

my tips for buying a used prius in our awful car market i just had to go through the excruciating process of buying a new used car yahoo i had to wait three weeks to buy a new car so i had plenty of time to drive myself crazy researching heres what i learned in case it helps someone else through the stressful process of buying a used car my price range was 10k or under my advice is from this position plenty told me this was going to be hard to find a car in this price range persevere you got this i ended up with a 2013 prius c 119k miles 8900 which i posted here a couple days ago my advice while its fresh on my mind priuses from 20102015 have a commonly known headgasket issue aka have to replace the engine in my price range i couldnt get a regular prius from 2016 and up so i went with a prius c instead different engine no headgasket problem in this price range i knew id be looking at 100k miles i went with a toyota because 100k miles is no biggie prius cs do have a commonly known headlight issue go outburn quicklyare dim youll be testdriving during the day but do your best to check out the headlight brightness shop the carfax more than the dealership carfaxes are no longer free oid news but not to me i only shopped the carfax website because i did not want to pay for a bunch of reports consumer reportscarcomplaintscom to research your specific year and model for issuesreliability ratings see if your library has cr for free buy the bestmaintained vehicle you can afford a great carfax is gonna show oil changes every 5k miles fluids flushed etc but carfax does not usually show momandpop shops mostly reports from dealerships and bigger autoshops so have some leeway that being said my previous car was perfect a yaris and had been in two minor accidents that didnt affect it at all this made me feel ok with including cars in minor accidents in my search how to get a hopefully good hybrid battery one of my biggest stressors was buying a prius with a still decent hybrid battery because i did not want to have to replace it anytime soon the batteries are less about mileage put on and more about time passed older battery more likely to need replacing sooner i used this subreddit to read up on folks with the year of prius cs i was looking at to gauge when id need to most likely replace it the batteries need to be used to stay in good health you actually do not want an older prius with too little miles for ex i test drove a 2013 prius c with 32k miles and the autoshop had had to replace the battery if the dealership is good with priuses theyll have tested the battery health and be able to tell you how it is even so have them test it with you if possible ask what the health is ask if the cells have been tested be annoying test on your own using the dr prius app use the monitoring systems to learn more during the test drive use the energy flow monitor to see if the vehicle is using both gas and electric power a good battery will use both while a bad one will rely more heavily on the gas pay attention to the mpg as you drive bad batteries have a decrease in fuel efficiency typically this would be below 40mpg check the cruising range to see how many miles the car is getting out of a tank of gas take this one with a grain of salt it is based off the past 23 fillups and thus the previous owners driving style mine showed they were only getting 300 miles per tank once i was able to drive mine around it jumped back up to the normal amount i dont even know how they were managing to get that bad of mpg on a prius lol the hybrid battery has a filterfan if you can have the dealership check and replace great if not do it yourself to help preserve the battery health last things check every last thing on the car when you test drive it even if it feels silly blinkers lights windshield wipers crank the acheat open and close doorstrunk one time one of the backdoors of the car wouldnt open make sure they lock parking break horn sideview mirror movement cruise control adjust the seat test usb ports connect to the bluetooth etc ive bought four used cars before the age of 35 i have finally learned it is worth it to be ridiculous and over the top at the dealership if all goes well youll never see those folks again unless they throw in some free oil changes best of luck to everyone in the throes of buying a new
